== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100672 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100672], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100672-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>2ac82f77311d1512a9506972bb60b3a522268640fae2cdb8c6c2d78b9c1baf85</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
